### Schedule

### Literature
- The **BL** listed below are section numbers from the course book Villani (2025a). [Bayesian Learning](https://github.com/mattiasvillani/BayesianLearningBook/raw/main/pdf/BayesBook.pdf).
- The **BLprequel** listed below are section numbers from a book [Bayesian Learning - the prequel](https://github.com/mattiasvillani/BayesianLearningBook/raw/main/pdf/PreBayesBook.pdf).
- The **BDA** listed below are section numbers from the course book Gelman, Carlin, Stern, Dunson, Vehtari, Rubin (2014). [Bayesian Data Analysis](http://www.stat.columbia.edu/~gelman/book/BDA3.pdf).

### Lecture contents

**Lecture 1 (Recorded, no physical class)- The likelihood function. Information. Basic Monte Carlo simulation.**\
Read: BL 1.1-1.2, BLprequel 8.3, 8.4, 8.6 (check that you know the concepts) | [Slides](/misc/larry.png) \
Interactive: [Second derivative as function curvature](https://observablehq.com/@mattiasvillani/second-derivative-measures-the-curvature-of-a-function) | [Likelihood and Information](https://observablehq.com/@mattiasvillani/likelihood-and-information) \

**Lecture 2 - Subjective probability and Bayesian learning. One-parameter models: iid Bernoulli, Gaussian and Poisson models. Summarizing a posterior distribution.**\
Read: BL 1.4, 1.5, 2.1-2.4 | [Slides](/misc/larry.png) \
Interactive: \
